name: presence
title: Presence
summary: People see who is online, away or offline, set a custom status that clears on its own, and pause notifications with Do Not Disturb.

env.name: PRESENCE_OFFLINE_TTL
env.doc: A device with no heartbeat for this long stops counting as online (Go duration; at least twice PRESENCE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL).

env.name: PRESENCE_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL
env.doc: How often clients send a heartbeat while the app is on screen (Go duration, at least 10s).

env.name: PRESENCE_IDLE_AFTER
env.doc: Minutes without input after which web clients report the person idle (away) (Go duration, at least 1m).

stitch: Decide who sees whose presence: presence.SetVisibilityPolicy (default: any signed-in user). With orgs installed, presence.SetVisibilityPolicy(presence.SharedGroupPolicy("org_members", "org_id", "user_id")) limits it to people who share an org.
Run custom status text through the content filter: presence.SetTextCheck(moderation.Check) when the moderation feature is installed.

Hold push and email during Do Not Disturb app-wide (notifications >= 1.1.0): notifications.AddDeliveryFilter("presence.dnd", func(ctx, n) (notifications.Hold, error) { on, err := presence.IsDND(ctx, d.Pool, n.UserID); return notifications.Hold{Push: on, Email: on}, err }). The channels feature registers it when installed.
Show presence where people appear: PresenceAvatar / UserPresenceDot from @/features/presence on web and mobile; usePresence(ids) batches every id on screen into one request.
Mobile: the Status row sits in Settings; move it to a profile or account sheet if the app has one.
